variable.description: Paste a token from a Login/Sign Up response here to use the Verify Token request

request.description:
Returns all product categories, used to populate the Shop dropdown, the homepage top-rated section, and the category tiles on the Shop page.

Response 200:
[{"id":2,"code":"k:ayakkabi","title":"Ayakkabı","img":"<url>","rating":4.9,"gender":"k"}, ...]

gender is "k" (kadın) or "e" (erkek). Category links use the pattern /shop/:gender/:categoryName/:categoryId where gender is spelled out (kadin/erkek) and categoryName is the part of `code` after the colon, e.g. id 2 -> /shop/kadin/ayakkabi/2.

Returns the list of available roles used to populate the role selection box on the Sign Up form.

Response 200:
[{"id":1,"name":"Yönetici","code":"admin"},{"id":2,"name":"Mağaza","code":"store"},{"id":3,"name":"Müşteri","code":"customer"}]

Registers a Store user (role_id: 2). Requires the nested `store` object with name, phone, tax_no and bank_account.

Response 201:
{"message":"User created. Check your email for activation instructions."}

Note: sending an extra field, a renamed field, or a missing required field returns a backend error.
